skill.name: skill-from-masters
skill.description: Help users create high-quality skills by discovering and incorporating proven methodologies from domain experts. Use this skill BEFORE skill-creator when users want to create a new skill - it enhances skill-creator by first identifying expert frameworks and best practices to incorporate. Triggers on requests like "help me create a skill for X" or "I want to make a skill that does Y". This skill guides methodology selection, then hands off to skill-creator for the actual skill generation.
skill.summary: Research expert methods before creating a new AI skill.
skill.author: GBSOSS

content.value_statement: Creating a useful AI skill requires more than generic instructions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to research proven expert methods before drafting the skill.
actual_capabilities: Maps a requested skill to one or more relevant methodology domains.
Uses a local methodology database of domain experts and frameworks.
Guides web research for primary sources, expert interviews, and proven examples.
Compares multiple expert approaches and highlights conflicts for user choice.
Extracts principles, processes, quality criteria, and common pitfalls for a new skill.
Hands the confirmed methodology foundation to skill-creator for final skill generation.
limitations: Requires web access when the local methodology database does not cover the domain.
Depends on public sources and may miss private or proprietary expert methods.
Needs user judgment to choose between competing expert frameworks.
Prepares methodology guidance but does not replace the final skill-creator step.

use_cases.title: Create a Domain Skill
use_cases.description: Identify proven frameworks before building a new skill for sales, product, writing, design, or engineering work.

use_cases.title: Improve Skill Quality
use_cases.description: Ground a draft skill in expert methods, primary sources, strong examples, and explicit quality checks.

use_cases.title: Compare Expert Methods
use_cases.description: Review several approaches in a domain and choose the best combination for a specific workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new skill idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a skill for writing customer interview plans. First, find proven expert methods I should use.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Domain
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with a known domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: I want a skill for product requirement documents. Map the domain, identify expert frameworks, and show the best sources to review.

prompt_templates.title: Select Methods
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that compares multiple schools of thought.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Amazon working backwards, Marty Cagan product discovery, and Teresa Torres continuous discovery for a PRD skill. Recommend a coherent foundation.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Skill Creator
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the selected methods to produce actionable principles, workflow steps, quality criteria, examples, and anti-patterns for skill-creator.

output_examples.input: I want to build a skill for writing sales emails.
output_examples.output: The skill maps the request to sales, copywriting, and persuasion. It suggests SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale, AIDA, and awareness-stage copywriting for review.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for better engineering code reviews.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies software engineering and feedback methods. It combines review quality checks, clear feedback language, and common review anti-patterns.

output_examples.input: Help me make a presentation coaching skill.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes storytelling, visual design, and persuasion frameworks. It asks the user to choose the best fit before drafting final instructions.

best_practices: Start with the user goal, target tasks, and quality bar before researching methods.
Use primary sources and strong examples before summarizing expert principles.
Choose one to three core methodologies so the final skill stays focused.
anti_patterns: Do not build a skill from generic advice without domain-specific expert methods.
Do not mix conflicting frameworks without explaining the tradeoffs to the user.
Do not skip examples, quality criteria, or common mistakes before handoff.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps research expert methodologies before creating a new AI skill.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before skill-creator when a skill needs domain expertise or a high quality bar.

faq.question: Does it create the final skill?
faq.answer: It prepares the methodology foundation, then hands off to skill-creator for final generation.

faq.question: Does it require web search?
faq.answer: It can use the local database first, but web search improves coverage and source quality.

faq.question: Can it combine multiple experts?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares approaches and helps the user choose one to three primary methods.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
